name: Exchange rates
description: Lets agents look up currency exchange rates, today's or a past date's, from the Frankfurter API.

tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: The latest reference exchange rates (European Central Bank, updated on working days) from one currency to others.

params.name: base
params.description: Three-letter currency code to convert from, like USD.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Currencies to convert to, comma separated, like EUR,GBP,JPY. All when left out.

tools.name: exchange_rates_on
tools.description: Reference exchange rates on a past date (YYYY-MM-DD), back to 1999.

params.name: base
params.description: Three-letter currency code to convert from.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Currencies to convert to, comma separated.
